profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ lululemon | Full-Stack Web Development
profile.summary:
Senior Engineer with 5+ years of experience building and optimizing scalable eCommerce platforms that deliver seamless, user-centric experiences. Expertise in React/NextJS, NodeJS, GraphQL, and AWS, with a proven track record of delivering high-impact solutions that drive business growth. 

Skilled in solving complex problems, ensuring system reliability, and implementing data-driven monitoring to maintain high availability and performance at scale. Passionate about mentoring junior developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, and driving engineering excellence. Focused on creating innovative, scalable solutions that meet the needs of fast-growing, global teams, and contributing to the success of mission-driven products.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead engineering efforts related to product education on the homepage, category details page (CDP), and product details page (PDP) to deliver seamless, high-performance user experiences.
• Provide technical leadership to the team, mentoring engineers on best practices, design patterns, scalable architecture, and code quality while fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous learning.
• Collaborate closely with product stakeholders, engineering architects, and other cross-functional teams to shape high-level technical decisions and architecture, ensuring features align with business goals and deliver exceptional user experiences.
• Own the full development lifecycle from design to deployment, ensuring production readiness, continuous improvement, and the integration of robust monitoring and alerting systems.
• Drive the integration of robust observability practices, using tools like Splunk, Sentry and Cloudwatch to actively monitor system performance and health.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
• Develop and scale lululemon store, ambassador, and community pages with React/NextJS and GraphQL to build high-performance, user-centric applications with optimized caching strategies using Akamai.
• Collaborate closely with UX and design teams to maintain a consistent, scalable design system through a shared pattern library, ensuring uniformity across complex, cross-platform experiences.
• Lead integration efforts with Contentful CMS, enabling dynamic, flexible content delivery while maintaining high availability and performance.
• Optimize CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, ensuring seamless, automated deployment processes and minimizing downtime during production releases.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including backend engineers and product managers, to ensure alignment on technical solutions, dependencies, and scalability, driving high-impact features in a fast-paced, agile environment.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• Architect and develop clean maintainable code across the full-stack of web technologies; in Agile (SAFe/SCRUM)
• Maintain and improve hybrid Angular/Ionic apps that are deployed to Android and iOS app stores
• Develop new RESTful APIs as microservices using NodeJS w/Express, Jest, SuperTest and containerized with Docker
• Design and implement database schemas for MongoDB w/Mongoose while maintaining legacy Oracle SQL databases
• Contribute to and maintain Jenkins/CloudBees continuous integration pipelines as they mature to continuous deployment
• Mentor junior developers on design-patterns and best-practices through pair programming and code-reviews

positions.title: IT Analyst
positions.description:
• 24x7 SaaS and infrastructure monitoring with tools such as Microsoft IIS, Zabbix, Pingdom, BigPanda and Sumo Logic
• Identified, tracked, diagnosed and escalated service outage incidents via ServiceNow, Jira and ITSM
• Searched and analyzed application data using SQL and Sumo Logic (AWS EC2/Lambda logs)
• Tested RESTful APIs (JSON/XML) via POSTMAN and monitored web services using Fiddler

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Interacted with project stakeholders, gathered requirements, developed strategies and solutions of high business value for over 600,000 members
• Our agile team team delivered software using a mixture of SCRUM and Kanban with 2 week long sprints
• Automated processes and reduced manual task times by up to 95%
• Tools Used: Magic (eDeveloper 9.4 & 2.5 XPA), Btrieve Database, Microsoft SQL, Wrike, VBA and VBs

positions.title: Android Security Test Engineer
positions.description:
Android Security Test Engineer
•  Executed various types of test cases on over 100 released and non-released devices, testing Android security, integrity, and functionality
•  Reduced testing time by 50% (14 hours to 7 hours) by automating test cases with Python & Shell as well as setting process standards
• Ran Python and Shell scripts/commands via ADB using a Linux emulator (Cygwin)
•  Document software issues and provide any necessary feedback
•  Helped replicate and troubleshoot defects with OEM 
•  Testing experience on Android Software 4.0 (Ice Cream Sandwich) - 5.0 (Lollipop) and mobile networks 2G/HSPE+/LTE/VoLTE
•  Bug Tracking Software: HP Quality Center and Bugzilla

Mobile Network Test Engineer/Support
•  Executed test cases and scripts on Rohde & Schwarz simulators for IMS VoLTE, VoLTE Border, UCE and IR94 test cases.
•  Analyzed call flow requests, call responses, call waiting, call barring, and 3-way calling. 
•  Responsible for collecting all logs and reporting test results and bugs observed

positions.title: Production Support Test Engineer/Intern
positions.description:
• Provided production support for millions of AT&T users on Amdocs’ DCM Billing System by planning, designing, and executing complex testing solutions (i.e. integration, regression, functional and acceptance testing)
• Contributed to two major releases and three bundles that were successfully implemented into production with 0% downtime working in Agile with Scrumban
• Tested Web Service APIs (REST/SOAP) using SoapUI and other internally developed tools
• Actively participated in internal design review of testing materials; checked test environments; executed, tracked, analyzed and communicated results
• Ran Unix shell scripts (.sh) to process batch files and automated certain task in Linux (Red Hat) via PuTTY.
• Interacted daily with client (AT&T) and Amdocs teams to deliver timely, high-quality work
• Tools used include: HP Quality Center, Jira, SoapUI, Linux/Unix, PuTTY, MySQL, and Oracle SQL Developer
